navy.role: primary ink, structure, the top and bottom bars

blue.role: connectors, joins, a second track; sparingly

amber.role: the warm accent: a gate, a rule under the header, an eyebrow

orange.role: the critical or degraded: the one line that has to land

red.role: hard problems, warnings, the unresolved; sparingly

primary.use: primary face: body and labels; the accessible default everywhere text reads

mono.use: eyebrows, section labels in small caps, numerals, codes, small technical labels

display.use: bold grotesque webfont for the sheet or poster title only; Helvetica Neue then Atkinson Hyperlegible as fallbacks

banned.use: Fraunces retired from the default 2026-08-01; never a system serif for display; never Arial in any position in a font stack, use system-ui as the fallback

rules.accent: color carries meaning; most of a surface is navy on cream; each accent appears where it means something (amber a gate or rule, orange the critical, blue a connector), never as decoration
rules.dashes: no dashes of any kind in copy; use commas or restructure
rules.motion: static preferred; at most one quiet reveal; respect reduced-motion
rules.voice: labels name the subject not the stance; no hype; do not narrate the structure
